category.name: Agri and Food Processing SPM
category.description: Empower your agri-business with our specialized machinery for food processing and agriculture. We design and build SPMs (Special Purpose Machines) tailored to optimize post-harvest processing, packaging, and quality assurance. From seed sorting to product packaging, our innovative solutions enhance productivity, reduce waste, and ensure compliance with food safety standards. Trust our expertise to deliver efficiency and value to your agricultural operations.

products.title: Onedril (SSM)
products.description: OneDril is a manual, portable seed-sowing machine designed for precise and efficient planting. Capable of handling seeds between 2 to 25mm, it follows the line-sowing principle for uniform crop growth. Ideal for micro and large seeds alike, OneDril’s ergonomic design ensures convenience and accuracy. It empowers farmers with a cost-effective, versatile solution for boosting agricultural productivity.
products.briefDetails: Onedril is a manually operated, portable seed sowing machine designed specifically for micro seeds but capable of handling seeds ranging from 2mm to 25mm. Built on the principle of line sowing, it ensures precise seed placement, optimal spacing, and improved germination. Its compact and ergonomic design makes it easy to carry and operate across various terrains, especially suitable for small to mid-sized farms. Onedril enhances sowing efficiency, reduces manual labor, and supports sustainable farming practices. It’s ideal for crops like millet, mustard, sunflower, and beans, making it a versatile tool for modern-day farmers seeking affordable, effective sowing solutions.

productDetails.title: Seed Plunger
productDetails.description: The Seed Plunger is a stainless steel mechanism with a cone for opening and closing to plunge seeds into the soil. It can vary the plunging depth from 1 cm to 6 cm. The plunging action is driven by a crank mechanism consisting of a crank, crankshaft, and connecting rod

productDetails.title: Seed Hopper
productDetails.description: The Seed Hopper holds seeds, and inside, a seed disk picks the required number of seeds (2mm to 25mm) and drops them into the plunger. The hopper is adjustable to sow one or more seeds at even intervals, depending on the seed type and spacing needs

productDetails.title: Handle
productDetails.description: The handle is used to push the machine forward, driving the wheel to actuate the plunger and seed disk. Designed for operators of various heights, it has a grip for comfortable handling. The handle's mechanism ensures smooth sowing operation and seed distribution

productDetails.title: Depth Adjustor
productDetails.description: The Depth Adjustor is an adapter that controls the wire tension for opening and closing the cone, adjusting the plunging depth. By changing the adapter's position, the cone’s slot changes accordingly, ensuring seeds are sown at the desired depth in the soil

products.title: Chilli Ladling Machine
products.description: This remote-operated Chilli Ladling Machine is engineered for efficient handling and ladling of chilies inside solar sheds. Its versatile design allows it to handle other crops like groundnuts and grains, ensuring optimal operation. With enhanced precision and ease of use, this machine reduces labor efforts and maximizes productivity for solar drying and similar agricultural processes.
products.briefDetails: The Chilli Ladling Machine is a specially designed, remote-operated system used to evenly ladle and spread chillies inside solar drying sheds. Engineered for precision and efficiency, it reduces manual labor while ensuring uniform drying—crucial for preserving quality and flavor. Though primarily built for chillies, it is versatile enough to handle other crops such as turmeric, tamarind, or herbs. Its adjustable control mechanism allows smooth, consistent operation, making it ideal for small processing units and agro-industries. This machine not only enhances productivity but also supports hygienic, large-scale drying with minimal human contact and improved operational safety.

productDetails.title: Motor
productDetails.description: The machine features a variable frequency drive motor that allows the conveyor speed to be adjusted according to the size and type of chili seeds being processed. This adjustable speed control ensures optimal handling and accurate ladling for different seed varieties.

productDetails.title: Food Grade Belt
productDetails.description: The conveyor belt is made of lightweight, food-grade plastic and is equipped with arm-like provisions across its surface for efficiently picking and transferring chilies. The durable belt ensures smooth, hygienic operation, moving the chilies with minimal friction and contamination.

productDetails.title: AFD Wheel drive
productDetails.description: The machine employs an all-wheel drive (AWD) system, where the motor powers all four wheels. This allows the machine to make crab turns with negligible turning radius. The remote-controlled knob enables smooth and precise directional changes with minimal effort.

products.title: Precision Slicing Machine
products.description: The Precision Slicing Machine delivers ultra-thin slices, as fine as 3mm, with exceptional accuracy. Designed for diverse food items, it can slice fruits, vegetables, and even delicate items like bread with high precision. This machine ensures uniformity and efficiency, making it a valuable asset for food processing, catering, and kitchen applications demanding consistent slicing quality.
products.briefDetails: The Precision Slicing Machine is a high-performance slicing solution engineered to deliver ultra-thin and uniform slices up to 3mm thickness. Designed for versatility, it can process a wide range of food items including potatoes, carrots, radish, onions, and even fruits like, Bread crisps,  apples or beetroot. Its robust blades ensure consistent results with minimal waste, making it ideal for commercial kitchens, food processing units, and snack industries. The compact design, easy-to-clean components, and safety-focused operation enhance user convenience. Whether for chips, salads, or garnishes, this machine guarantees precision, speed, and superior quality in every cut, boosting efficiency in food preparation.

productDetails.title: Slider Involute Blade
productDetails.description: This is a specially designed involute blade with its center of mass strategically placed for precise and sharp slicing. It ensures thin cuts, allowing for slices even less than 2.5 mm. Made of stainless steel, the blade guarantees durability and accuracy in slicing various products.

productDetails.title: Loft loading section
productDetails.description: The loft loading section has five compartments, each holding a loaf ready for slicing. A linear actuator pushes each loaf towards the blade for precise cutting, enabling continuous operation and smooth processing of multiple loaves one at a time.

productDetails.title: Receiving conveyor
productDetails.description: After slicing, the slices drop onto the receiving conveyor. The speed of the conveyor determines how the slices are arranged, ensuring that the product is neatly placed. This system maintains an orderly flow of sliced products for easy handling.

productDetails.title: Slider blade motor
productDetails.description: A variable frequency drive motor controls the slider blade, adjusting its speed based on the conveyor’s pace. As the conveyor speed varies, the motor ensures that the placement of bread slices aligns with the loaf production, maintaining consistency in output.

products.title: Tamarind Breaking machine
products.description: This innovative Tamarind Breaking Machine simplifies the process of breaking tamarind pods while preserving seed and pulp quality. Designed for agricultural efficiency, it is robust and user-friendly, suitable for small and large-scale operations. The machine boosts productivity and minimizes manual effort, making it an essential tool for tamarind producers.
products.briefDetails: The Tamarind Breaking Machine is a robust and efficient solution designed to break and separate tamarind pods with minimal manual effort. Engineered for agro-processing industries and small-scale farmers, it gently cracks open the shells without damaging the pulp, ensuring higher yield and better product quality. Its stainless steel components offer durability and hygiene, while the machine’s user-friendly design supports easy operation and maintenance. It significantly reduces labor costs and increases processing speed, making it ideal for seasonal and bulk tamarind handling. Adaptable for similar shell-based crops like groundnuts or dry peas, this machine enhances productivity and post-harvest efficiency.

productDetails.title: Tamarind OUT conveyor
productDetails.description: The Tamarind OUT conveyor is responsible for moving the tamarind pods after they have been broken. It ensures a smooth flow of processed tamarind, transporting it efficiently for further handling or packaging.

productDetails.title: Actuator arm
productDetails.description: The actuator arm is positioned above the Tamarind IN conveyor. Once the tamarind pods are arranged, the actuator applies a calculated amount of force to precisely break the pods. This controlled action ensures the tamarind is broken without damaging the pulp

productDetails.title: Tamarind IN conveyor
productDetails.description: The Tamarind IN conveyor features a square wedge section where the tamarind pods are carefully arranged. Made of food-grade plastic, this area ensures safe, hygienic handling of the tamarind while positioning it optimally for the breaking process

products.title: Bailing Machine
products.description: A cost-effective Bailing Machine designed to compress carton boxes to one-fourth of their original volume. Its robust design ensures reliability and efficiency, reducing storage space and simplifying waste management. Suitable for warehouses, recycling centers, and packaging units, this machine offers an economical and practical solution for handling bulk waste materials
products.briefDetails: The Bailing Machine is a compact, low-cost solution designed to compress and bundle carton boxes and similar recyclable materials into one-fourth of their original volume. Ideal for small warehouses, retail stores, and recycling centers, it helps reduce storage space and transportation costs. The machine features a durable frame, easy-lever operation, and safety mechanisms to ensure reliable, user-friendly performance. Its energy-efficient design makes it suitable for both urban and rural setups. Beyond carton boxes, it can also handle materials like paper waste and plastic wrappers. This machine promotes sustainable waste management and streamlines disposal processes for eco-conscious operations

productDetails.title: Motorized screw jack
productDetails.description: The machine uses a Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) motor, allowing the drum speed to be adjusted based on the type of food product being cleaned. This flexibility ensures optimal cleaning efficiency for different produce, making the machine versatile for various applications.

productDetails.title: Loading and unloading area
productDetails.description: The Rotatable Handle allows the drum to tilt for easy unloading. It features a locking mechanism with a needle; when removed, the drum rotates freely, and when inserted, the drum locks in place. This ensures secure operation and controlled product handling.

productDetails.title: Container
productDetails.description: A lightweight belt drive mechanism is used to rotate the drum. The belt system is efficient, with minimal transition distance, ensuring smooth operation and reducing the mechanical load on the motor, making it ideal for this cleaning application.

products.title: Spinach Cleaning Machine
products.description: This Spinach Cleaning Machine cleans and semi-dries spinach with ease and precision. Its adaptable design allows it to handle other crops like lettuce, coriander, and fenugreek. Ideal for agricultural and food processing operations, it ensures hygiene and quality while saving time and labor. This machine is a perfect solution for pre-processing leafy vegetables and herbs
products.briefDetails: The Spinach Cleaning Machine is a compact, efficient solution designed to wash and semi-dry leafy vegetables like spinach, fenugreek, coriander, and amaranthus. Equipped with a multi-stage cleaning system, it gently removes soil, dust, and other impurities while maintaining the natural texture and freshness of the leaves. The semi-drying feature reduces moisture without damaging the produce, making it ideal for packaging and further processing. Its stainless-steel construction ensures hygiene, durability, and ease of cleaning. Perfect for small-scale farmers, vegetable vendors, and food processing units, this machine streamlines post-harvest handling, reduces labor, and enhances produce quality and shelf life.

Trust our expertise to ensure your products are tested thoroughly and perform optimally under all conditions

category.name: Reciprocating Arm
category.description: Achieve mechanical precision with our Reciprocating Arms. These versatile solutions are engineered for applications requiring linear motion, including material handling, assembly, and automation tasks. Built with durable materials and cutting-edge design, our arms ensure smooth operation and consistent performance. Enhance your workflow with our customizable reciprocating arm systems, tailored to meet the specific demands of your industrial processes.

products.title: Vertical Reciprocator
products.description: A reciprocating machine equipped with a brake gear motor, for horizontal and vertical moving features, allows for consistent, even coverage while maintaining control and stability. Ideal for industrial applications like painting, spraying, and coating industries
products.briefDetails: Reciprocating painting machines automate the application of coatings, ensuring uniform coverage and high-quality finishes. They improve efficiency by minimizing overspray and high-volume production,

productDetails.title: Belt drive
productDetails.description: The reciprocator is designed for short or long stroke operation. The guns can be mounted in a horizontal or vertical arrangement.The heavy load version of Axis is capable of carrying up to 100 kg.  A high number of guns with extreme precision and high reliability.The working range can be customizable from 3 to 10. Foot from the floor

products.title: Horizontal Reciprocator
products.description: The X-axis serves as the foundation for configuring multi-axis systems and is utilized across various automation levels of a coating line. Its overall stability and high load capacity contribute to reliable operation and flexible application arrangements of the associated components
products.briefDetails: Horizontal reciprocators are utilized in various applications, including paint spraying, powder coating, mirror coating, and even in some machine tools where the workpiece moves horizontally for grinding or machining

productDetails.title: Horizontal Bed Drive
productDetails.description: The axis automatically position a vertical reciprocator to the object, adapting the gun to the object's width, Free axis programming,storable programming, and technology are integrated in the control

products.title: Synchronizing Reciprocator
products.description: The reciprocator moves multiple lines synchronously with the conveying motion of the objects. It is used for inside coating and other difficult applications
products.briefDetails: The process typically involves using a synchroscope to monitor the phase and frequency   difference   between   the generator and the grid, and then adjusting the generator's speed until they match Enables   maximum   contour   coating, increases   productivity,   and   reduces process times, even at high line speeds

productDetails.title: Vertical arrangement
productDetails.description: The axis is synchronized with the movement of the conveyor. The axis is the basis for setting up multi-axis systems and is used in various automation levels of a coating system

category.name: Actuator
category.description: Power your operations with our high-performance Actuators. Designed for precision and efficiency, our actuators deliver smooth and controlled motion across a variety of applications. From industrial automation to heavy machinery, we offer a range of electric, hydraulic, and pneumatic actuators to suit your needs. Experience enhanced productivity and reliability with our innovative actuator solutions

products.title: Electrical Actuator
products.description: Electric actuators convert electrical energy into mechanical motion using an electric motor and various mechanical components. This process involves a motor's rotational motion being transformed into either linear or rotary motion, depending on the actuator's design. The converted mechanical energy then powers the desired task,such as controlling valves, moving robotic arms, or adjusting various mechanisms
products.briefDetails: electric actuators are versatile devices that play a crucial role in modern automation and control systems by converting electrical energy into mechanical motion, enabling precise and efficient control of various industrial processes and machinery

productDetails.title: Electrical motor drive
productDetails.description: An electric actuator is a linear motion device that utilizes a rod extending and retracting from a housing to generate linear motion, allowing it to push or pull objects in a linear direction

category.name: Research & Development
category.description: Explore cutting-edge innovation with our Research and Development team. We specialize in creating tailored solutions for complex challenges, leveraging advanced technologies and industry expertise. From concept design to prototyping and testing, we deliver groundbreaking products that redefine efficiency and functionality. Partner with us to transform ideas into reality, ensuring your business stays ahead of the competition in a rapidly evolving technological landscape

products.title: Hydration tracking (G-sensor)
products.description: An innovative R&D project designed to measure water levels inside a bottle and track the amount consumed with exceptional accuracy of 10mm. It provides hydration reminders at user-specified or AI-recommended intervals, enhancing hydration habits. This technology integrates advanced sensors for real-time monitoring and ensures precision, making it ideal for personalized hydration management and improving overall wellness
products.briefDetails: This advanced hydration tracking system is an R&D innovation that utilizes a G-sensor and intelligent algorithms to accurately measure the amount of water consumed directly from a bottle. With an impressive accuracy of up to 10mm water level detection, the system monitors the intake each time the user drinks and updates hydration status in real time. It supports both user-defined reminder intervals and AI/ML-based smart recommendations that learn from daily habits, body metrics, and environmental factors. Ideal for fitness enthusiasts, patients, professionals, and general users aiming for better health, this system promotes personalized hydration habits, reduces dehydration risk, and ensures timely reminders—all within a sleek, integrated design for use in smart bottles or other containers

products.title: Portable Heating, cooling device using semiconductor
products.description: A groundbreaking R&D innovation featuring a compact semiconductor-based heating and cooling system. This portable device is small enough to integrate seamlessly into a water bottle and versatile for applications like kettles, tiffin boxes, table coffee warmers/coolers, kitchen appliances, and medical devices. It redefines thermal management, offering convenience, efficiency, and adaptability for diverse personal, professional, and industrial use cases

products.title: LoRa mesh system with encryption
products.description: This R&D project introduces a highly secure LoRa mesh communication system capable of transmitting signals over a 10km radius. It offers encrypted, long-range connectivity ideal for remote monitoring, smart agriculture, disaster management, industrial automation, and IoT networks. Its robust design enables seamless communication in isolated or large-scale environments, making it an excellent choice for applications demanding extended coverage and reliable data transfer.
products.briefDetails: The LoRa Mesh System with Encryption is a robust R&D-based long-range wireless communication solution designed for secure, decentralized data transmission across a 10km radius. Unlike traditional point-to-point systems, this mesh network enables multiple nodes to relay data, ensuring strong signal integrity even in remote or obstructed environments. With built-in encryption, it offers high-level data security, making it suitable for sensitive and mission-critical applications. The system is ideal for smart agriculture, disaster management, military communication, industrial automation, campus-wide IoT setups, and rural connectivity solutions. Its low power consumption and wide coverage make it a scalable, cost-effective alternative to traditional cellular networks for smart cities and infrastructure.

category.name: Electronics Product Engineering
category.description: Discover the future of connected living with our IoT Smart Products. We design and develop intelligent solutions that integrate seamlessly into everyday life, offering convenience, efficiency, and control. From home automation to industrial monitoring, our products ensure enhanced performance through real-time data and remote accessibility. Revolutionize your operations with smart devices built to meet the demands of modern lifestyles and business environments

products.title: Hydrogen (Smart-water-bottle)
products.description: Hydrogen is an AI-powered smart water bottle that features rapid heating and cooling, hydration tracking with advanced sensors, and personalized reminders for optimal water intake. Its ergonomic squircle design ensures style and comfort, while its innovative technology offers superior functionality. Perfect for on-the-go hydration, it redefines smart drinking solutions with intelligence, performance, and modern aesthetics
products.briefDetails: HydroGen is a next-generation smart water bottle designed to revolutionize personal hydration. It features an AI/ML-based hydration tracking system with a built-in G-sensor that monitors water intake with up to 10mm accuracy. The bottle integrates a compact semiconductor-based heating and cooling unit, allowing users to enjoy water at their preferred temperature on the go. Its ergonomic squircle (square + circle) design ensures a comfortable grip, while customizable LED indicators provide hydration reminders at user-defined or AI-recommended intervals. HydroGen combines health insights, advanced technology, and sleek design, making it ideal for daily use at work, school, gym, or travel

productDetails.title: Soft Touch button
productDetails.description: The soft touch button enables users to easily change modes, allowing for seamless transitions between heating, cooling, standby, and off settings. Its responsive design ensures quick activation and enhances user convenience, making it simple to adjust the bottle’s functions according to personal preferences.

productDetails.title: Responsive Led
productDetails.description: The responsive LED lights on the Hydrogen bottle visually indicate various statuses, such as temperature, hydration goals, or mode selection. These vibrant lights change colors based on user interactions, providing clear feedback on the current function and enhancing user engagement while promoting healthy hydration habits

productDetails.title: PCB Board
productDetails.description: The PCB board serves as the brain of the Hydrogen smart water bottle, integrating all electronic components and ensuring efficient communication between sensors, the app screen, and LED indicators. This compact board manages power distribution, data processing, and connectivity, facilitating seamless operation of the bottle's smart features.

productDetails.title: Air vent
productDetails.description: The Hydrogen smart water bottle features an air vent that allows hot air from the fan to escape, effectively releasing heat generated by the heatsink. This ventilation system ensures optimal temperature control, preventing overheating and maintaining the efficiency of the heating and cooling functions.

productDetails.title: App screen
productDetails.description: The integrated app screen offers a user-friendly interface for monitoring hydration levels, tracking water intake, and customizing settings. Through Bluetooth connectivity, users can sync their smart water bottle with their smartphones, providing real-time data and reminders to help maintain healthy hydration habits effortlessly.

products.title: RFID Child Tracking Device
products.description: A versatile child safety solution available as a card, module, or watch, this RFID tracking device ensures real-time location updates and customizable alerts. It’s adaptable for school, play, and travel, and extends its utility to applications like pet tracking, asset management, and workforce monitoring. This device offers parents peace of mind and provides efficient tracking for a wide range of needs
products.briefDetails: The RFID Child Tracking Device is a reliable and innovative safety solution designed to monitor and ensure the real-time location of children in schools, parks, or public spaces. With a tracking range of up to 200 meters, the system uses RFID tags available in card, wristband, or module forms—customizable to suit different use cases. It alerts guardians or school staff if a child moves beyond the designated safe zone, enhancing security without compromising freedom. The system supports integration with attendance management and access control systems. Built for ease of use and minimal maintenance, it’s ideal for schools, daycare centers, theme parks, and public events.

productDetails.title: Watch model
productDetails.description: The watch model is designed like a tag that can be securely tied to a child’s wrist. It offers a comfortable and non-intrusive way to track the child’s location, resembling a simple wristband while containing essential tracking technology for safety purposes

productDetails.title: RFID Reader
productDetails.description: The RFID Reader includes multiple antennas that emit radio waves to detect and communicate with nearby RFID tags. It captures signals from the tag and relays the information, allowing parents or guardians to monitor the child's location accurately through the tracking system.

productDetails.title: Tag Model
productDetails.description: The tag uses radio waves to transmit its identity and information to RFID readers. It can be passive or active, with passive tags relying on the reader for power and lacking a battery. This energy-efficient design ensures longer-term tracking without frequent maintenance.

products.title: Smart Furniture
products.description: Experience the future of home and office living with Smart Furniture. Featuring wireless charging, a built-in beverage heating and cooling system, intelligent lighting, and a retractable arm system for holding laptops or books with a nightlight. It also includes pop-up sockets and AI voice assistance for basic electronic controls like lights and AC. Smart Furniture combines functionality, comfort, and technology to redefine your personal and professional spaces
products.briefDetails: The Smart Furniture – Carbon Series is a multifunctional innovation combining comfort, technology, and productivity. Designed for homes, offices, and tech-enabled spaces, it features built-in wireless charging, a beverage heating and cooling system, an intelligent light setup, and a retractable arm to hold books or laptops—ideal for night reading or work. It also includes a pop-up socket hub and AI voice assistance for controlling devices like lights, fans, or AC. Crafted with ergonomic and modular design principles, Carbon enhances both functionality and aesthetics. Perfect for modern lifestyles, it supports efficiency, reduces clutter, and creates a seamless smart workspace or relaxation zone

productDetails.title: Beverage warmer and cooler
productDetails.description: The smart table includes a Beverage Warmer and Cooler, which adjusts or maintains the temperature of a beverage placed on it according to the user’s input. It provides a convenient way to keep drinks warm or cool without manual intervention, enhancing the overall experience.

productDetails.title: Wireless Charger
productDetails.description: The table features an omnidirectional wireless charger, allowing electronic devices like phones, watches, and earbuds to charge efficiently. Devices with wireless charging capabilities can be placed in any direction on the surface, ensuring fast and convenient charging for multiple gadgets.

productDetails.title: 360 Sound Speaker
productDetails.description: The 360 Sound Speaker is a 3D surround system integrated into the table, delivering high-quality sound. It adapts to the music and atmosphere, creating an immersive audio experience. The speaker is designed to enhance ambiance and provide consistent sound from all directions

productDetails.title: Floating Light Effect
productDetails.description: The Floating Light Effect adds an elegant touch to the table, adjusting its intensity based on the music being played. It also functions as a night path light, offering soft illumination during the night, making it both a stylish and practical feature for any environment

productDetails.title: Retractable Table
productDetails.description: The Retractable Table is designed for convenience, transforming into a laptop or book table with a simple press. The adjustable arms allow for easy use while in bed, and it includes a light, making it ideal for reading or working in various comfortable positions.

products.title: S Connect (Smart Speaker)
products.description: S Connect is a next-gen smart speaker combining premium sound quality with intelligent voice control. It connects seamlessly to your smart devices, enabling hands-free operation and integration with IoT systems. Designed for versatility, it fits effortlessly into any setting, offering personalized assistance, dynamic entertainment, and superior connectivity. S Connect transforms your space into a hub of convenience and innovation.
products.briefDetails: S Connect is an AI-powered smart speaker crafted for seamless voice interaction and intelligent control. Designed to integrate effortlessly into smart homes, offices, and learning environments, it supports voice commands for managing connected devices like lights, fans, AC, and more. The speaker offers clear audio output for music, calls, and announcements while also enabling personalized reminders, daily updates, and voice notes. Equipped with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity, S Connect serves as a smart hub that bridges IoT devices and enhances automation. Its sleek, minimalistic design complements any space, making it a versatile addition for productivity, comfort, and entertainment.

productDetails.title: Surround Speaker
productDetails.description: The Connect S features a high-quality surround speaker system that delivers immersive 360-degree sound. Designed to fill the room with clear, crisp audio, the speaker adapts to various sound profiles, providing an exceptional listening experience for music, podcasts, and voice commands from any corner of the room.

productDetails.title: Display
productDetails.description: The smart speaker includes a built-in display that shows essential information like time, track details, weather updates, and notifications. This sleek, user-friendly screen offers a visual complement to the voice interaction, enhancing the overall functionality and convenience of the Connect S.

productDetails.title: Responsive light
productDetails.description: The Connect S is equipped with a responsive light feature that adjusts its brightness and color based on sound or voice activity. It enhances the ambiance of the room, reacting dynamically to music, commands, or notifications, making the interaction with the speaker visually engaging and stylish.

productDetails.title: Volume Nobe
productDetails.description: The Connect S features a tactile volume knob for easy and precise audio control. Designed for intuitive use, this smooth, responsive knob allows users to quickly adjust the volume level, offering a simple yet effective alternative to voice commands or app-based controls.

category.name: Stellar labs
category.description: Stellar Labs is a unified platform that merges workflow optimization with rapid digital solution delivery. By integrating the auditing capabilities of Agentcy with the streamlined website development process of Stello, it offers end-to-end support—from analyzing and refining business operations to building tailored web solutions. Stellar Labs empowers organizations to identify inefficiencies, gather structured requirements, and implement solutions efficiently. This cohesive approach enhances operational clarity, accelerates digital transformation, and delivers measurable value with precision and responsiveness

products.title: Stello
products.description: Stello is an efficient application designed to streamline the collection of client requirements through a structured Business Requirement Document (BRD). Once the BRD is finalized, the platform enables the rapid development of customized websites, delivered within 48 hours. Engineered for operational efficiency and precision, Stello enhances communication between clients and agents, ensuring a smooth and effective transition from planning to execution. It serves as a reliable bridge between requirement gathering and timely website deployment
products.briefDetails: Stello simplifies the process of creating websites by obtaining client needs through a formal Business Requirement Document (BRD). Capturing detailed inputs from clients, agents use these inputs as a basis for creating bespoke, high-quality websites efficiently and accurately. The platform ensures open communication, eliminates confusion, and supports alignment of client expectations with end-results. By integrating requirement gathering with action seamlessly, Stello provides an enhanced, customer-focused process that is built around reliability, responsiveness, and professional standards

productDetails.title: Homepage
productDetails.description: The Stello homepage serves as a gateway to a streamlined website creation experience, guiding users through requirement collection and project initiation. With a clean, intuitive interface, it allows agents to quickly capture client needs using the BRD framework. Core features and progress indicators are easily accessible, ensuring users remain informed and engaged throughout the process. The homepage reflects Stello’s commitment to clarity, speed, and professionalism, providing a seamless entry point for efficient, goal-driven website development.

productDetails.title: BRD (Business Requirement Document)
productDetails.description: The BRD (Business Requirement Document) page is the core of Stello’s requirement-gathering process. It offers a structured, user-friendly interface where agents can input detailed client specifications across key categories such as objectives, features, design preferences, and functionality. The page ensures that all essential information is captured accurately, minimizing ambiguity and aligning expectations. With guided prompts and validation checks, the BRD page enables efficient, comprehensive data collection that forms the foundation for successful and timely website development.

products.title: The AiGentcy
products.description: Agentcy is a web-based platform offering audit and consulting solutions to improve business workflows. It begins by analyzing a company’s current processes and identifying inefficiencies through detailed audit reports.Based on the findings, Agentcy provides customized,actionable solutions to streamline operations, reducewaste, and enhance productivity. From optimizing coordination to automating tasks, Agentcy empowers businesses to implement practical improvements. It provides a data-driven foundation for informed decision-making and continuous improvement across all levels of the organization
products.briefDetails: Agentcy provides end-to-end workflow improvement through audit-led insights and customized consulting. Having performed an exhaustive analysis of a business, it presents elaborate reports identifying areas of inefficiency and scope for improvement. The platform then furnishes actionable, data-led recommendations—process automation to team redesign—that align with business objectives. Agentcy not just suggests improvements but assists in implementing them, thus enabling businesses to attain measurable levels of efficiency, decision-making, and sustainable growth

productDetails.title: Homepage
productDetails.description: The Agentcy introduces a modern platform dedicated to transforming business processes through AI-driven solutions. It highlights the integration of advanced technologies aimed at enhancing operational efficiency and decision-making. The platform emphasizes reengineering existing workflows to make them more agile and responsive to market dynamics. With a user-centric design, Agentcy ensures intuitive navigation, allowing users to leverage its features without a steep learning curve.Scalability is a key aspect, accommodating businesses of various sizes and evolving needs. category.name: Edifai (Simplify your business)
category.description: Edifai is a powerful suite of business applications designed to streamline operations and boost productivity. It includes Stacia Reimbursement for efficient expense management, Stacia Calendar for seamless scheduling and coordination, and Stacia Forms for digitizing and automating workflows and much more. Edifai helps businesses reduce manual tasks, enhance collaboration, and improve decision-making through integrated, user-friendly tools. Whether managing finances,organizing meetings, or collecting data, Edifai provides a smart, centralized solution to keep your business running smoothly and efficiently

products.title: Stacia Calendar
products.description: Stacia Calendar streamlines scheduling and team coordination by centralizing meetings, deadlines, and events. It integrates seamlessly with other tools, allowing users to manage availability, send invites, and track shared calendars effortlessly. Designed to enhance productivity, it minimizes scheduling conflicts and keeps teams aligned with automated reminders, smart booking features, and real-time updates across departments or project groups
products.briefDetails: Stacia Calendar is a smart scheduling tool that brings organization and visibility to business planning. esigned for teams, it supports shared calendars, meeting invites, and automatic reminders to ensure everyone stays in sync. It integrates with ommunication and productivity platforms, allowing seamless updates and coordination. Users can check availability, avoid double-bookings, and plan recurring events with ease. With color-coded categorization, customizable views, and real-time updates, Stacia Calendar enhances time anagement and team productivity, whether coordinating projects, meetings, or company-wide events.

products.title: Stacia Forms
products.description: Stacia Forms digitizes data collection and workflow automation across business processes. From employee onboarding to client feedback,it enables the creation, distribution, and analysis of custom forms without coding. With robust templates, approval routing, and real-time collaboration, teams can eliminate paperwork, reduce errors, and accelerate decision-making. It’s a flexible, secure solution to streamline data-driven tasks and enhance operational efficiency across departments
products.briefDetails: Stacia Forms empowers businesses to create, share, and manage digital forms for any workflow—from internal requests to customer surveys. With a drag-and-drop builder, users can design custom forms without coding. Built-in logic, workflow routing, and e-signatures streamline approvals and reduce delays.Responses are automatically captured and organized, with export and analytics options available for insights. Stacia Forms integrates with other Edifai tools to support end-to-end processes, ensuring smooth collaboration and eliminating the need for paper-based systems. It’s secure, user-friendly, and calable to fit any business need.

products.title: Stacia Reimbursement
products.description: Stacia Reimbursement simplifies expense management by allowing employees to submit claims quickly and managers to approve them with ease. It ensures faster processing, transparency, and accurate tracking of business expenses. With intuitive workflows, built-in compliance checks, and real-time status updates, this tool reduces paperwork and reimbursement delays, making financial operations smoother and more efficient for both staff and administrators
products.briefDetails: Stacia Reimbursement is built to take the hassle out of managing employee expenses. It allows users to submit reimbursement requests with receipts, categorize expenses, and track approvals in real time. Finance teams gain greater visibility into pending,while automated workflows reduce approval time and errors. Integrated policy checks ensure compliance, and detailed reporting helps with budgeting and audits. Stacia Reimbursement supports mobile access, making it easy for employees to manage claims on the go, and helps businesses maintain financial transparency and control without the dministrative burden
